records.question: If Subaru grew up without ever going to the other world, would he live on without having an occupation? What would happen to Subaru if he went through “a life in a different world starting from no occupation” sort of thing? Specifically speaking, if he were to be a middle-aged man with views of a high school student that tried to rush into the different world, he would probably fall into nothing but despair, huh.
records.answerSnippet: Nope. If he never went to the other world he would get scolded by Kenichi(his father) around the time he’d graduated high school and would withdraw from being a hikikomori. Kenichi would then suppo...
records.answerSearchText: Nope. If he never went to the other world he would get scolded by Kenichi(his father) around the time he’d graduated high school and would withdraw from being a hikikomori. Kenichi would then support Subaru by rehabilitating him in his workplace. After about 2 years, he would enter university, graduate as a loner, become a working adult, and with stability of those reasonably essential qualities, he would honestly be living life as a full-fledged member of society, and then he would cling on to a kouhai with such a heart that-a Rem kind of heart-she would find his incompetence cute. They would have a normal marriage, and then he would live a suitably happy life until he died. There’s no way his dad would continue to be that irresponsible towards his son, you know?

records.question: You said that Reinhard drains away all the mana, but what would happen if he were to get close to, or touch, a magic machine? records.answerSearchText: Magic devices are basically not a part of life, so it’s no problem. There’s no worries about causing a problem at a level that would make everyday life inconvenient. Frankly, it’s taking away the mana that a magic device works with, so it’s alright to think of it like an appliance that doesn’t have enough electricity to run. records.answerSearchText: Warriors use the mana in their bodies to support them in combat, sort of like fighting spirit. It’s not done consciously, more like the mana responds to what they want to do. So, although Subaru could manage a certain level of it, he doesn’t love the sword enough to throw half his life into it, and he wasn’t blessed with sword talent, so it’s probably impossible. records.question: I thought that Petelgeuse could only possess certain individuals, but I guess I was mistaken. If I wasn’t mistaken, is there a reason for it? Also, can he exist in a state where he’s not possessing anyone?
records.answerSnippet: The only people Petelgeuse is able to possess are those who are suited to being possessed and controlled by him. A trained spirit arts user, or someone who is simply physically resilient. The metho...
records.answerSearchText: The only people Petelgeuse is able to possess are those who are suited to being possessed and controlled by him. A trained spirit arts user, or someone who is simply physically resilient. The method of checking is using the miasma of ‘Sloth’; someone who fails their sanity point check is no longer able to fight against Petelgeuse. Also, as Petelgeuse is an irregular spirit, he’s not able to exist in the state where he’s not possessing someone. If he could do that, he wouldn’t have done something like pursuing in a body that was nearly a corpse.

records.answerSnippet: It’s not really that deep a thought. Putting it extremely, stopping any of the organs is going to bring about some sort of irregularity in your vital functions. It’s simply that, to make Regulus’ a...
records.answerSearchText: It’s not really that deep a thought. Putting it extremely, stopping any of the organs is going to bring about some sort of irregularity in your vital functions. It’s simply that, to make Regulus’ authority easy to understand, and use a easy-to-convey concept of ‘life’ that people would recognize, saying that ‘It must not be stopped’ about the ‘heart’ is understandable and carries a strong meaning; that’s all. For now, I went with prioritizing the concept of the heart.

records.answerSearchText: She was told that even though he’s not needed, and no one is all that worried about him, he can’t make up his mind, and thinks “It’s my fault. If I don’t do my best, it’ll be terrible for everyone.”, to put it politely.

records.question: Typhon’s authority shattered Minerva’s right arm when she physically hit her; would (non-physical) actions with evil intent be judged as ‘evil’ and turn out the same way? In concrete terms, if there was a grey cat who wrote a story with interesting developments and fascinating characters, who joyfully took the especially popular blue-haired rising heroine off the stage, and went on to drop the readers to rock-bottom with that super-happy story, what punishment might be inflicted?
records.answerSnippet: Since it wasn’t done with evil intent, it would end with the wonderful result of no one being hurt.
records.answerSearchText: Since it wasn’t done with evil intent, it would end with the wonderful result of no one being hurt.

records.question: I was thinking about it, but if a Great Rabbit was introduced into an area with a Black Snake, wouldn’t one side collapse the other? records.question: If Daphne-chan wanted to, could she create a super-mabeasts with the special abilities of the White Whale, Great Rabbit, and Black Snake?

records.question: If the White Whale, Great Rabbit, and Black Snake were to fight, what order would they die in?

records.question: Around how much of the population in Lugunica is Republican? (note: seems to be referencing the idea of rule by the people, rather than rule by the monarchy.)
records.answerSnippet: Honestly, there’s not many. Out of the large countries, Kararagi is close, but the other three are entirely monarchies. Lugunica, in particular, has the treaty with the dragon, so their royal famil...
records.answerSearchText: Honestly, there’s not many. Out of the large countries, Kararagi is close, but the other three are entirely monarchies. Lugunica, in particular, has the treaty with the dragon, so their royal family’s authority (if not their practical ability) is quite strong, and there’s not enough political problems from the nobles to mention, so things are stable. They basically have the worldview that incompetent or evil people won’t rise to the top.

records.answerSearchText: With the capital in the center, there are large cities placed like a six-pointed star, with populations around 200,000 to 300,000 people. Aside from those, small cities are scattered about, and it continues down through towns, villages, and settlements, you see. If you only look at humans, they mostly live in villages, but there are cases where demihumans create settlements in the mountains and woods and live there. Relations are quite bad.

records.answerSearchText: Frankly, it hasn’t had enough influence to mention, but there’s sort of a sense that ‘If something happens, the dragon won’t come to help.’. records.answerSearchText: Honestly, it’s not like there’s a waterfall way on the far side of a body of water; you run into the Great Waterfall pretty much right at the edge of the world, so the Great Waterfall mostly doesn’t have any bodies of water that you could call a sea or lake. The environment here is too harsh to be something you could call a Mother Ocean.

records.answerSearchText: They might not recognize your identity, but it’s not like it’s preventing them from recognizing your existence, so someone wearing a hood entering the women’s bath would be odd, and get caught, just like normal. records.question: Are people without an affinity completely unable to use magic? Or is it more a problem of being suitable or not?

records.answerSearchText: People without any affinity whatsoever are fairly rare, so for the most part, those who make an effort will be able to use it. Of course, there are individual differences between the limits that will be reached. People without any affinity will be unable to use magic. Think of it as being less likely than people who get a useful blessing. Even Subaru can use magic, after all.

records.answerSearchText: Even without something as confusing as that, someone like Beatrice can use the activation key and fire off a ‘Shamac’ without words.

records.question: I like black; is anyone in the story black?

records.question: I think that Shamac is a smokescreen-style magic, but why is Al Shamac able to interfere with other dimensions? What kind of relationship does it have with that spell name?
records.answerSnippet: The “Shamac” line isn’t a smokescreen, it breaks the connection between the mind and body of targets in it’s radius. With Shamac, the body loses it’s perception. With El Shamac, the body becomes un...
records.answerSearchText: The “Shamac” line isn’t a smokescreen, it breaks the connection between the mind and body of targets in it’s radius. With Shamac, the body loses it’s perception. With El Shamac, the body becomes unable to be controlled. With Ul Shamac, the mind gets tossed out (literally: the mind gets German Suplexed). With Al Shamac, the body gets sent to another world along with it.

records.question: I think that if incanting a spell causes magic to activate, then it wouldn’t be impossible to discover new magic by putting appropriate-seeming words one after another, followed by constructing an appropriate-seeming mental image. Is there anyone who activates magic and discovers magic like this?
records.answerSnippet: In short, the thing that causes a mental image to take form is called an ‘incantation’, so even while chanting the fire incantation ‘Goa’, if the person chanting thinks of it as a ‘wind’ incantatio...
records.answerSearchText: In short, the thing that causes a mental image to take form is called an ‘incantation’, so even while chanting the fire incantation ‘Goa’, if the person chanting thinks of it as a ‘wind’ incantation, wind magic will be activated. It might be difficult to say ‘Goa’ and actually get ‘Fuura’ magic.

records.question: If you look at Beatrice’s Door Crossing from the back, how does it look?
records.answerSnippet: I’m not sure I understand what you mean by ‘from the back’, but probably, if I assume you mean looking at it from inside the attached room, the opened door wouldn’t open for some strange reason. In...
records.answerSearchText: I’m not sure I understand what you mean by ‘from the back’, but probably, if I assume you mean looking at it from inside the attached room, the opened door wouldn’t open for some strange reason. In the case where you fly to the forbidden library from Door A, if you view Door A from Room A, Door A wouldn’t budge at all. This could drive someone crazy.

records.question: If you thoroughly researched magic to manipulate time and control space, what level could you use it at?
records.answerSnippet: “Come back the day before yesterday” -> “I’m here” would be possible.
records.answerSearchText: “Come back the day before yesterday” -> “I’m here” would be possible.

records.question: If your odo is used up, will you die? Can’t you take in mana from the surroundings?
records.answerSnippet: You get a fixed amount of odo when you’re born, and you can’t restore it, is how things are set up in Re: Zero. If your odo runs out you won’t die, but you won’t be yourself anymore, and in the end...
records.answerSearchText: You get a fixed amount of odo when you’re born, and you can’t restore it, is how things are set up in Re: Zero. If your odo runs out you won’t die, but you won’t be yourself anymore, and in the end you’ll be crippled.

records.question: In Hunter x Hunter, it’s sort of like you can tell someone’s powers from their personality, but in the world of Re: Zero, are magic affinities and blessings related in some way to personality? records.answerSnippet: There’s not really a connection between personality and magic affinity, you see. There are people with fire affinity that have very cold personalities, and there are people with earth affinity that...
records.answerSearchText: There’s not really a connection between personality and magic affinity, you see. There are people with fire affinity that have very cold personalities, and there are people with earth affinity that have very little patience. People who have useless blessings will generally be biased against people with useful blessings.

records.question: In Re: Zero’s world, are there a vast number of ancient magics that have been lost, as you’d expect?

records.answerSearchText: There’s a fair number of magics that were not handed down, not written down, and simply forgotten. Echidna remembers all of them, however.

records.question: In ice magic, there’s both use of fire mana like Puck, and use of water mana like Rem, but are there differences according to the affinity?
records.answerSnippet: Rem’s water mana is able to create ice pillars and attack with them, but it can’t freeze an opponent or object like Puck’s fire mana. On the other hand, fire mana can’t heal, or create large amount...
records.answerSearchText: Rem’s water mana is able to create ice pillars and attack with them, but it can’t freeze an opponent or object like Puck’s fire mana. On the other hand, fire mana can’t heal, or create large amounts of water like water mana can, you see. The part where they create ice pillars and attack with them is the same.

records.question: In the Re: Zero world, are all the spells that currently exist ones that have been passed down from ancient times? Are any new spells being developed?
records.answerSnippet: Nothing’s being developed, you see. They’re satisfied with what they have. Normally the people who’ve reached the pinnacles of magic would be developing more, but in Lugunica, Ferris and Roswaal ha...
records.answerSearchText: Nothing’s being developed, you see. They’re satisfied with what they have. Normally the people who’ve reached the pinnacles of magic would be developing more, but in Lugunica, Ferris and Roswaal haven’t got any interest in that at all.

records.question: In the Re: Zero world, is it theoretically possible to combine Goa-style and Hyuma-style into something like Medloah? (note: Dragon Quest reference)

records.answerSearchText: Someone who can use both at once could do it, but things like compound magic are difficult. Creating a whirlwind with wind magic, and adding fire to make it something like a firestorm wouldn’t be impossible for Roswaal if he had Subaru’s imagination.

records.question: In the state where a door in the mansion and the forbidden library are attached, what happens if you destroy the door? Is the door indestructible? Is the attachment forcibly cut?
records.answerSnippet: I suspect that a phenomenon similar to a forced cancellation of the attachment would occur. It’s ‘Door Crossing’, so at the moment the door is destroyed, the link would most likely be cut.
records.answerSearchText: I suspect that a phenomenon similar to a forced cancellation of the attachment would occur. It’s ‘Door Crossing’, so at the moment the door is destroyed, the link would most likely be cut.

records.question: Is learning magic the process of learning to see in your mind the image of the magic you want to use? Also, even if you have a solid mental image, will the magic still not activate without the incantation? Isn’t there any other activation key?
records.answerSnippet: An ‘incantation’ is just the normal method to consciously hit the activation switch. Roswaal and Beatrice use magic without chanting; that’s because they’re able to press the start switch on magic ...
records.answerSearchText: An ‘incantation’ is just the normal method to consciously hit the activation switch. Roswaal and Beatrice use magic without chanting; that’s because they’re able to press the start switch on magic without speaking. When you’ve mastered it that well, you can use magic even if you can’t speak.

records.question: Is magic activated simply by calling the name of the spell? It looks like difficult magic can’t be used except by powerful people, but what elements are necessary to use magic?
records.answerSnippet: When you prepare the needed mana, visualize how you want to use the magic, get your gate working, and use the incantation, you can use magic. The necessary elements are firstly the preparation of t...
records.answerSearchText: When you prepare the needed mana, visualize how you want to use the magic, get your gate working, and use the incantation, you can use magic. The necessary elements are firstly the preparation of the needed mana, proper mental image of the magic to be used, and enough basic ability with your gate to activate the magic in the first place. It’s like the way that in order to throw a one-hundred-meter ball, you need the ball and the throwing form and a shoulder capable of long throws.

records.question: Is the caster unable to control the shape of the darkness produced by Shamac? If Subaru could produce a Shamac in the shape of a dragon, I think it would startle crying children.

records.answerSearchText: It’s impossible for Subaru, but I think if Beako or someone like that put their mind to it, they could most likely do it. Having said that, even if you don’t limit it to Shamac, Roswaal could do it with flames or ice, but there’s probably not much meaning to doing it. It wouldn’t chance the power of a Kaiser Phoenix, but you could do it.

records.question: Now that you mention it, why is magic a jumbled five-element-style mix of the four elements and light and shadow?

records.question: Putting Roswaal’s three titles together, he’s the “Traffic Light”.

records.question: Since Re: Zero is a fantasy world, you can easily make up and use spell names and really cool nicknames, but what are the names of spells or people’s nicknames that the author particularly likes?
records.answerSnippet: Looks like it would burn with a ‘goa’ sound -> ‘Goa’. Looks like it would freeze with a ‘hyuma’ sound -> ‘Huma’. Looks like it would blow away with a ‘fura’ sound -> ‘Fura’. The feel of the sound l...
records.answerSearchText: Looks like it would burn with a ‘goa’ sound -> ‘Goa’. Looks like it would freeze with a ‘hyuma’ sound -> ‘Huma’. Looks like it would blow away with a ‘fura’ sound -> ‘Fura’. The feel of the sound lines up, so earth is fine with ‘Dona’...... Darkness is blinding, so ‘shakohkahten’ (note: shading curtain, with curtain taken from the English word) -> ‘shakohmaku’ (note: shading curtain) -> ‘shamaku’ -> ‘Shamac’ is good, I guess…… It’s that kind of approach, so I’m really sorry in regards to magic. I hadn’t really intended to use my head enough to make it interesting. I feel like I haven’t used many nicknames, either, aside from “Sword Demon”, “Master Swordsman”, and “Clown”. Here, too, I didn’t really use my head enough to make it interesting. Please don’t expect anything from me besides things around the story itself. I’ve got some ideas there.

records.question: Subaru-kun carved a spiral groove in Minya (note: character from a children’s TV show), but is it basically possible to use a mental image to add craftsmanship to magic?

records.question: The Al-class, Ul-class, and El-class of magic power have shown up, so is there also Il-class and Ol-class magic?

records.question: The Master Swordsman is the person with the strongest sword, right? Does the person with the strongest magic have a title of some kind?

In Lugunica, “Blue” is Ferris, “Red” and “Green” and “Yellow” are all held together by Roswaal. “Black” and “White” are absent. records.question: The forbidden library burned along with the Roswaal manor, but does that mean the library’s space was within the Roswaal manor?

records.question: Do spirit arts users see the forms of spirits here and there, similar to how people in the real world with strong spiritual senses can receive impressions?

records.answerSearchText: Spirits basically don’t take on a real form as long as they’re not called, so I don’t think they’d be seen peeking out here and there. records.question: Is Macgregor Mathers the origin of Roswaal’s name, perhaps? I think the origin of Beatrice’s name is Beatrice (note: second Beatrice was written to match the Italian pronunciation), but are there other characters with stories behind their names?
records.answerSnippet: I borrowed Reinhard from The Legend of Galactic Heroes’ Emperor of the Galaxy, outside of that there’s no particular stories behind them. Roswaal, too, was decided on for the sound of it, and it’s ...
records.answerSearchText: I borrowed Reinhard from The Legend of Galactic Heroes’ Emperor of the Galaxy, outside of that there’s no particular stories behind them. Roswaal, too, was decided on for the sound of it, and it’s not a name that I thought “I’ll do this!’ and brought it in from somewhere. Now that I think back on it, maybe the reason that I thought Mathers sounded like a magic user was I had the idea that Suikoden 2 had a strong magic user of that name? Beako wasn’t from Beatrice, but started from the idea of ‘A girl that it would look right to hold like a teddy bear’, so the ‘Beako’ nickname came first, and I picked the rest later (note: In the Japanese text, bear is pronounced the same as the ‘Bea’ section of Beako). I think that’s about all of it.

records.answerSearchText: I’m not bothered by crude content in something I think of as ‘A work with that sort of thing’. I play erotic games, too. But, I don’t think of my work as ‘A work with that sort of thing’, and I, myself, don’t think of that as something that needs to be shown openly, so I dislike waving it around. records.question: When you’re thinking of Regulus’ and Batenkaitos’ lines, what sort of mood are you in while writing? Batenkaitos strings together words with similar meanings, but isn’t it very difficult to think up Regulus’ theories?
records.answerSnippet: In the author’s head, if there’s a solid backbone of what characters called ‘Regulus’ or ‘Batenkaitos’ are thinking, and what kind of expressions they use, then it’s not very difficult to make them...
records.answerSearchText: In the author’s head, if there’s a solid backbone of what characters called ‘Regulus’ or ‘Batenkaitos’ are thinking, and what kind of expressions they use, then it’s not very difficult to make them talk, I think. It’s not that the author is thinking of those theories, when Regulus, with that sort of personality and that sort of nature, speaks, it naturally turns into those kinds of theories. People talk about ‘characters moving by themselves’, but similarly, ‘characters speaking for themselves’ is common too, and as a writer I lean particularly strongly in that direction. So, I’ve never had trouble with a character’s personality. If the author properly grasps how a biased person’s thoughts are put together, then the biased person’s human nature will naturally show up in their actions and words.

records.question: I didn’t really understand the reason that our gullible heroine, Beako, had, in the past, rejected people who had tried to take her away, and Subaru in the on-the-way loops, but in the final loop, she responded fondly to him. What on earth was the deciding factor there?

records.answerSearchText: It’s because he laughed off Beako’s insistence on being hung up on ‘that person’ as silly, and had Beako choose ‘the best’. All the people up to that point had not known about ‘that person’, or on the other hand even if they did know, they were the type to say ‘I’ll become that person’. Hence, they couldn’t overcome Beako’s internal priority for the ‘Command from Mother’. In Subaru’s case, he handed the right to choose to Beako, and Beako herself broke down the order of ‘Subaru’ > ‘that person’ > ‘Command from Mother’. I’m sorry I wasn’t able to depict that very well. You should apologize too, please, for not being able to pick it up from reading.

records.question: Garfiel was able to use his Blessing of the Earth Spirit even on the upper floors of the mansion, but does that mean he’s able to use the blessing when he’s in contact with any part of an object that’s in contact with the ground? In that case, wouldn’t he be able to use the blessing even inside a dragon carriage in motion?
records.answerSnippet: To a certain extent, if it’s something that can be visualized as ‘ground’, it’s possible. of course bare dirt works, but I feel it’s not that difficult to think of buildings on top of the dirt, or ...
records.answerSearchText: To a certain extent, if it’s something that can be visualized as ‘ground’, it’s possible. of course bare dirt works, but I feel it’s not that difficult to think of buildings on top of the dirt, or even the floor on upper levels as ‘ground’. On the other hand, looking at the floor of a moving vehicle as ground is something that I’d like to be careful of, even as a writer. If it’s a stopped dragon carriage, you might think of it that way, but when you add the condition of it being in motion, it’s perhaps difficult to think of it as ground.

records.question: If Julius' quasispirits continue to progress normally, how far could they progress? Also, I'm interested in the conditions under which spirits can gain ranking.
records.answerSnippet: If no one interferes, and they grow vigorously, a spirit can, in the end, grow into a "Great Spirit". There are rankings amongst the Great Spirits, too, so please think of it being like the way tha...
records.answerSearchText: If no one interferes, and they grow vigorously, a spirit can, in the end, grow into a "Great Spirit". records.answerSearchText: He does have various problems, but despite that, she thinks it's Roswaal. Frederica is the type that believes people are basically good.

records.question: I'd like to request a Frederica episode in the Emilia camp that would make you smile.

records.answerSearchText: Actually, it's rare for there to be as many people at the Roswaal manor as there are now, so she's running about every day saying "Ah, I'm so busy, I'm so busy" while enjoying it, and until she becomes used to it she'll be doing her job with a grin; Ram will tell her "That's eerie." and her face will get red and she'll be upset. Perhaps something like that has happened.

records.question: If Frederica and Emilia were to arm-wrestle, who would win?
records.answerSnippet: They're pretty evenly matched... if she beast-changed, then Frederica, if not then Emilia.
records.answerSearchText: They're pretty evenly matched... if she beast-changed, then Frederica, if not then Emilia.

records.question: If Frederica were to take the trials, what would she see?
records.answerSnippet: "Trials" can only be seen by people with regrets, so Frederica nee-sama doesn't have the qualifications to take the trials.
records.answerSearchText: "Trials" can only be seen by people with regrets, so Frederica nee-sama doesn't have the qualifications to take the trials.

records.question: If someone were to attempt to abduct Frederica, how might she react?

records.answerSearchText: I think perhaps she'd beast-change, and leave the abductor behind in moments.

records.question: If there's a pleasant episode with young Frederica and Clind, I'd like to know about it.
records.answerSnippet: When Frederica was a child, she used to follow handsome, kind Clind around no matter where he went. She'd be jealous if he was kind to anyone else, then she'd openly tell him that and get a sad smi...
records.answerSearchText: When Frederica was a child, she used to follow handsome, kind Clind around no matter where he went. She'd be jealous if he was kind to anyone else, then she'd openly tell him that and get a sad smile in return...... It's something the current Frederica would like to forget.

records.question: If you were to try petting beast-changed Frederica, how would that go?

records.answerSearchText: She's a leopard, so I have the mental image of her hair not being that long, but the feel of it would be smooth like you'd touched an incredibly good carpet, I think.

records.question: In arc four, Garfiel was surprised that Frederica had grown taller; around how many centimeters did she grow after leaving Sanctuary??
records.answerSnippet: I think you'll understand if you look at the frontispiece of the novel, when Frederica left "Sanctuary" she was only around seven or eight years old, so since then she'd probably grown around eight...
records.answerSearchText: I think you'll understand if you look at the frontispiece of the novel, when Frederica left "Sanctuary" she was only around seven or eight years old, so since then she'd probably grown around eighty centimeters.

records.question: In terms of their fighting skill, which of Frederia and Garfiel is stronger?
records.answerSnippet: Overwhelmingly Garf. A serious Frederica is about the same as Rem.
records.answerSearchText: Overwhelmingly Garf. A serious Frederica is about the same as Rem.

records.question: In the bottom of her heart, what does she think about Garf liking Ram?
records.answerSnippet: At the bottom of her heart or not, she's not trying to hide anything; she thinks her little brother's romance will be a thorny path, just like normal. She knows about Ram's firm feelings about the ...
records.answerSearchText: At the bottom of her heart or not, she's not trying to hide anything; she thinks her little brother's romance will be a thorny path, just like normal. She knows about Ram's firm feelings about the one she cares about, so even while thinking that it's going to be rough, it's her little brother so she looks at it in a favorable light.

records.question: In the novel, there was a scene with Subaru wearing Frederica's maid outfit, but has Frederica ever has a chance to wear a butler outfit?

records.answerSearchText: Frederica's chest is a little big, so the butler outfit might be a little too small. Incidentally, the time when Subaru was dressing as a woman, that was Frederica's dress, too. More than you'd expect, the two of them have been sharing Frederica's dresses without her permission, and such.

records.question: In the period when Garfiel had trouble dealing with Otto and was somewhat prickly towards him, did Frederica scold him, try to do something about it... was there anything like that?
records.answerSnippet: Garfiel's problems are Garfiel's problems, and there wasn't any hostility to it, so I think she just kept an eye on it like normal. It would be different if someone had come to talk to her about it...
records.answerSearchText: Garfiel's problems are Garfiel's problems, and there wasn't any hostility to it, so I think she just kept an eye on it like normal. It would be different if someone had come to talk to her about it, but no one was really too troubled by it.

records.question: Is Frederica the type of onee-chan who bathes with her younger brother even after she's gotten older?
records.answerSnippet: Above all, Frederica is the type of onee-chan who dislikes bathing. But, she uses reason to supresses her instinct to dislike it, and gets in the bath. She gets back out extremely quickly. However,...
records.answerSearchText: Above all, Frederica is the type of onee-chan who dislikes bathing. But, she uses reason to supresses her instinct to dislike it, and gets in the bath. She gets back out extremely quickly. However, washing her hair is a lot of trouble. Getting in with Petra is fun, so she stays a long time. Garfiel is in and out in a flash.

records.question: Is beast-change a skill that's specific to Frederica and Garf?
records.answerSnippet: It's an ability that can be used by any half-beast. They normally learn how to control it when they're little, so Frederica can control it, but Garfiel didn't learn so it's sort of like he goes ber...
records.answerSearchText: It's an ability that can be used by any half-beast. They normally learn how to control it when they're little, so Frederica can control it, but Garfiel didn't learn so it's sort of like he goes berserk.

records.question: Is her power as a maid greater than RemRam?
records.answerSnippet: If by power as a maid, you mean what you might call her collective strength at maid duties, then it goes without saying that she's overwhelmingly greater than Ram, and perhaps greater than Rem by a...
records.answerSearchText: If by power as a maid, you mean what you might call her collective strength at maid duties, then it goes without saying that she's overwhelmingly greater than Ram, and perhaps greater than Rem by a small margin. Rem is just slightly better at cooking, and Frederica would win at everything else, that sort of mental image.

records.question: Is there anything like a killer move that Frederica can do when she's beast-changed?
records.answerSnippet: If I had to say, I think maybe something like dashing in at super high speed and biting her opponent, then doing a 'death roll' where she twists around while still biting and ripping them apart, bu...
records.answerSearchText: If I had to say, I think maybe something like dashing in at super high speed and biting her opponent, then doing a 'death roll' where she twists around while still biting and ripping them apart, but the Re: Zero world doesn't have that much of the concept of killer moves.

records.question: Is there anything that Frederica-san has trouble dealing with?
records.answerSnippet: If you're talking about the full range of maid responsibilities, there isn't any particular area she has trouble with. If you look at fields outside of that, she has trouble with rain and thunder. ...
records.answerSearchText: If you're talking about the full range of maid responsibilities, there isn't any particular area she has trouble with. If you look at fields outside of that, she has trouble with rain and thunder. She gets soaked, and surprised, after all.

records.question: It seems her tooth issues were corrected by Clind-san, but was she gnawing on hard things and such until then?
records.answerSnippet: Regardless of the place, she had the bad habit of chewing on various things when her teeth became itchy, but that's been fixed. Now, she chooses the place, carefully picks things that are alright t...
records.answerSearchText: Regardless of the place, she had the bad habit of chewing on various things when her teeth became itchy, but that's been fixed. Now, she chooses the place, carefully picks things that are alright to chew on, and chews on them. She has the sort of body where her teeth continue to grow, after all. It's the same as rodents.

records.question: It seems that she wears down her teeth by biting knives, but does she trim her claws with a similar method?
records.answerSnippet: She doesn't do things like wearing down her claws like a cat does, so I think she probably trims them with a nail clipper.
records.answerSearchText: She doesn't do things like wearing down her claws like a cat does, so I think she probably trims them with a nail clipper.

records.question: Just after she became a maid, how good was Frederica at housekeeping and cooking?
records.answerSnippet: When she had newly become a maid, she'd hardly been taught anything yet, so there wasn't anything she could do. There was only that, when she was leaving "Sanctuary", she'd been taught the recipe f...
records.answerSearchText: When she had newly become a maid, she'd hardly been taught anything yet, so there wasn't anything she could do. There was only that, when she was leaving "Sanctuary", she'd been taught the recipe for meat pies by Lewes, so the beginning of Frederica's maid life was practicing until she could make them. Furthermore, Clind instructed her.

records.question: On the battlefield, besides using beast-change, can Frederica nee-sama use magic to attack as well?
records.answerSnippet: Frederica hasn't developed the magical side of things, so she can't launch magic attacks. Her affinity is wind magic, but she's no match for Ram, so she's completely devoted to physical combat. Whe...
records.answerSearchText: Frederica hasn't developed the magical side of things, so she can't launch magic attacks. Her affinity is wind magic, but she's no match for Ram, so she's completely devoted to physical combat. When she's beast-changed into the female leopard state, most opponents are no match for her.

records.question: Out of the Re: Zero characters currently appearing, please tell me which one Frederica would just barely defeat in a serious fight.
records.answerSnippet: That would be Rem.
records.answerSearchText: That would be Rem.

records.question: Please tell me a bittersweet episode from the time when Frederica called Clind onii-sama!
records.answerSnippet: When Frederica was little, Clind treated her as importantly as a princess, so from how to treat a lady to the mindset of a servant, she learned it all from Clind. She declared that, in the future, ...
records.answerSearchText: When Frederica was little, Clind treated her as importantly as a princess, so from how to treat a lady to the mindset of a servant, she learned it all from Clind. She declared that, in the future, she would become a maid that Clind wouldn't be ashamed of, but Clind replied "The future, is it. Hopes and fears.", already lamenting the future.

records.question: Please tell me her first impression of Subaru!
records.answerSnippet: I'd heard of it beforehand, but he's a gentleman with an scary look to his eyes, isn't he.
records.answerSearchText: I'd heard of it beforehand, but he's a gentleman with an scary look to his eyes, isn't he.

records.question: Setting aside Ram and Garf that she's known since long ago, which member of the Emilia camp is Frederica most fond of?
records.answerSnippet: With those conditions, I can only say Petra...
records.answerSearchText: With those conditions, I can only say Petra...

records.question: Since she was always written of as having a scary face, I thought "She must be fairly rough-looking.", but when I saw the illustration of her, it was different than I had imagined, and cute. How was it when you saw the illustration, Professor Cat? Was it different than your mental image, perhaps?
records.answerSnippet: I don't have a mental image of the characters when I'm writing, so what Ootsuka-sensei draws is my image. Hence, it's never been different from my mental image, and it never will be.
records.answerSearchText: I don't have a mental image of the characters when I'm writing, so what Ootsuka-sensei draws is my image. Hence, it's never been different from my mental image, and it never will be.

records.question: Subaru gives the girls of the Emilia camp nicknames: Emilia > Emilia-tan, Rem > Rem-rin, Ram > Ram-chi, Beatrice > Beako, is what he called them I think, but if he were to give Frederica a nickname, what might it be?
records.answerSnippet: Rika-chama. Respect to Higurashi.
records.answerSearchText: Rika-chama. Respect to Higurashi.

records.question: The long-skirt maid outfit looks very good on Frederica, but what kind of reaction would she have if she wore a mini-skirt outfit like Ram or Petra...?
records.answerSnippet: She'd say "It wouldn't look good on a large lady like me, after all. This sort of clothing is for adorable girls like Petra or Ram... at the very least, cute on the outside.", and she wouldn't wear...
records.answerSearchText: She'd say "It wouldn't look good on a large lady like me, after all. This sort of clothing is for adorable girls like Petra or Ram... at the very least, cute on the outside.", and she wouldn't wear it.

records.question: To Frederica, what are Ram and Garfiel?
records.answerSnippet: Frederica nee-sama's looks on them as a little sister and little brother, so she dearly wishes for both of them to become happy.
records.answerSearchText: Frederica nee-sama's looks on them as a little sister and little brother, so she dearly wishes for both of them to become happy.

records.question: Was Frederica taking care of Meili? Did the two of them ever chat or something?
records.answerSnippet: Everyone was taking care of Meili, so of course, I think there were times when Frederica was taking care of her, too. Frederica is basically kind to everyone, so she took a suitable attitude toward...
records.answerSearchText: Everyone was taking care of Meili, so of course, I think there were times when Frederica was taking care of her, too. Frederica is basically kind to everyone, so she took a suitable attitude towards Meili as well. Having said that, she was aware of having been involved in Elsa's death, so perhaps she didn't try to get that close.

records.question: What are Frederica-san's hobbies?
records.answerSnippet: Collecting dolls, and putting cute clothes on them. She doesn't think that cute clothing looks good on her large frame, so it seems she enjoys that kind of play. Recently Petra tries on different o...
records.answerSearchText: Collecting dolls, and putting cute clothes on them. She doesn't think that cute clothing looks good on her large frame, so it seems she enjoys that kind of play. Recently Petra tries on different outfits for her, and she's satisfied. But, she's a little shy about it when Petra tries to get her to try different outfits, too.

records.question: What did Frederica think of Rem?
records.answerSnippet: She doted on her, but Rem stubbornly refused to call her Frederica nee-sama, and that was the period that she would only look to Ram, so she felt like there was a wall between them.
records.answerSearchText: She doted on her, but Rem stubbornly refused to call her Frederica nee-sama, and that was the period that she would only look to Ram, so she felt like there was a wall between them.

records.question: What does Frederica think about Garfiel and Mimi?
records.answerSnippet: To begin with, Frederica hasn't encountered Mimi, so she hasn't heard anything yet.
records.answerSearchText: To begin with, Frederica hasn't encountered Mimi, so she hasn't heard anything yet.

records.question: What does she think about Clind-san? Has there been any change in her feelings between the past and now?
records.answerSnippet: In the past, he was her first love, and now she's trying to forget that.
records.answerSearchText: In the past, he was her first love, and now she's trying to forget that.

records.question: What food is Frederica-san best at making?
records.answerSnippet: The food that's her best specialty is the meat pie that she learned from Lewes, and that Roswaal further perfected.
records.answerSearchText: The food that's her best specialty is the meat pie that she learned from Lewes, and that Roswaal further perfected.

records.question: What games does it seem like Frederica would play in Re: Zero Academy?

records.answerSearchText: Frederica-sensei is famous for liking board games. She's not that good at them, but she's the advisor for the non-powered game club, so she's having fun with it. She's not good at them.

records.question: What impression does she have of Ram (not of when the two of them were together, but her now that she's forgotten Rem)?

records.answerSearchText: She's very worried about her, as she's being too hard on herself in regards to her forgotten sister. Out of the Emilia camp, Frederica is the one that worries about Ram the most.

records.question: What is Frederica nee-sama's greatest speciality dish?
records.answerSnippet: The meat pie she learned directly from Lewes. After leaving "Sanctuary", when she began to study various things as a maid, the first dish she learned to make was this meat pie, too.
records.answerSearchText: The meat pie she learned directly from Lewes. After leaving "Sanctuary", when she began to study various things as a maid, the first dish she learned to make was this meat pie, too.

records.question: What kind of birthday gifts would the people of the Emilia camp give to Frederica?
records.answerSnippet: At the current point in time, Frederica is the highest authority in the mansion (in terms of balance of power), so she'd be sent things that were good as bribes...I'm kidding, but they're all peopl...
records.answerSearchText: At the current point in time, Frederica is the highest authority in the mansion (in terms of balance of power), so she'd be sent things that were good as bribes...I'm kidding, but they're all people who are being helped out by her, so I think they'd run around a fair amount for her. Petra would put the most effort into the present, so maybe the rest of them would be little things as thanks for her work from day to day.

records.question: What might she feel about how Garfiel has fallen for Ram?
records.answerSnippet: Even for my little brother, he's chosen quite a thorny path, indeed...
records.answerSearchText: Even for my little brother, he's chosen quite a thorny path, indeed...

records.question: What sort of a situation with a man would Lady Frederica long for?

records.question: What sort of feelings does Frederica-san have towards Otto?
records.answerSnippet: He's a man who shoulders many responsibilities, so there's no end to his troubles. We're a camp where men who aren't like that are uncommon, though...... no one would complain if he set down his bu...
records.answerSearchText: He's a man who shoulders many responsibilities, so there's no end to his troubles. We're a camp where men who aren't like that are uncommon, though...... no one would complain if he set down his burdens a little bit. I'm sure he himself is the last one who would allow that. That part of Otto-sama really is what makes him Otto-sama.

records.question: What was Frederica nee-sama's first impression of Emilia-tan?
records.answerSnippet: Since she's a half-elf, she's probably had a very hard life up until now. Hence, I'll have to be kind to her so nothing unpleasant happens to her here at the Miload manor. (Frederica and Emilia's f...
records.answerSearchText: Since she's a half-elf, she's probably had a very hard life up until now. Hence, I'll have to be kind to her so nothing unpleasant happens to her here at the Miload manor. (Frederica and Emilia's first meeting was after the time Emilia was mistaken for a maid.)

records.question: What was the win-loss ratio for Frederica and Garfiel's battles(?) when they were little?
records.answerSnippet: An unbroken string of losses for Garfiel.
records.answerSearchText: An unbroken string of losses for Garfiel.

records.question: What were the circumstances of her becoming a maid?
records.answerSnippet: She was living in "Sanctuary", and was able to leave the forest since she was a quarter-beastman. Due to that, to be ready for the day that "Sanctuary" was opened, or that Garfiel came to the outsi...
records.answerSearchText: She was living in "Sanctuary", and was able to leave the forest since she was a quarter-beastman. Due to that, to be ready for the day that "Sanctuary" was opened, or that Garfiel came to the outside, in order to be able to help everyone, she went to find a place for them in the outside world. After that, it's just the normal flow of relying on Roswaal, and becoming a maid at the Mathers household.

records.question: What's the origin of Frederica's name?
records.answerSnippet: Somehow or other, when I was trying to think of a high-class name, that name came to me.
records.answerSearchText: Somehow or other, when I was trying to think of a high-class name, that name came to me.

records.question: When she returns from beast-changing, what happens with her clothes?

records.question: When they're beast-changed, between Frederica and Garfiel, which is bigger?

records.question: While working as a maid at the Roswaal manor, is there any of Roswaal's behavior that made her think "I wish he'd stop that, at least."?

records.question: Why does Frederica wear her hair long?

records.question: Will Frederica's father make an appearance after this?

records.question: Does Reinahrd perhaps know Felt's true name?

records.question: Is there some reason that this is Otto's birthday?

records.answerSearchText: When I was deciding the character's birthday, I took the sound of "Hard work (leaves a mark) on you" (note: The Japanese pronunciation in parentheses matches uncommon pronunciations for 3, 2, and 4.) and made it March 24th. Incidentally, his ground-dragon buddy Verhoe is September 6th (note: similarly, the pronunciation for 9 and 6 is similar to the sound of the term used here for hard work) so together they're the "Hard work leaves a mark on you" combo.

records.answerSearchText: Otto is being targeted by an assassin hired by the daughter of an influential person in his hometown, and when he left home, he made a show of saying “I won’t accept any help! I’ll show you I can do it myself!” or something, so he probably didn’t want to start working under someone, he wanted to make his own way as a travelling merchant. Despite that, he’s the Minister of the Interior. Where did he go wrong.

records.question: With that, if you’ll pardon a question.  What would bring Otto happiness?
records.answerSnippet: Owning his own store; having that dream come true, or something like that. He hasn’t given up.
records.answerSearchText: Owning his own store; having that dream come true, or something like that. He hasn’t given up.

records.question: Would it be correct to say “Eight Arms” Kurgan is a spider-type demihuman? Or did Vollachia’s technology or magic give him eight arms?
records.answerSnippet: He was born in a rare tribe of multi-armed people. Their characteristic is having more arms than normal, but even in their tribe, eight arms is top-level. Learning to use all of them well takes abo...
records.answerSearchText: He was born in a rare tribe of multi-armed people. Their characteristic is having more arms than normal, but even in their tribe, eight arms is top-level. Learning to use all of them well takes about twice as much effort as Tenshinhan’s arm-increasing technique.

records.answerSnippet: I think the hybrid Crusch-sama from the later half of Re: Zero is lovely.
records.answerSearchText: I think the hybrid Crusch-sama from the later half of Re: Zero is lovely.

records.question: ‘Invisible Providence’ is not only so long that it’s hard to say, but frankly, it’s uncool. The most important thing for a special move is the sound of it’s name, I’d say.
